entry.summary: 吴说获悉，据 Base 开发者 @wbnns 表示，Base 今日将把区块的 Gas Target 提升至 26 Mgas/s。据了解，去年 9 月 Base 已确定了 1 Ggas/s（即 1000 Mgas/s） 的扩容目标，并计划以每周 1 Mgas/s 的增幅逐步扩展。通过提高区块的 Gas Target，网络可以在相同时间内容纳更多交易，从而在需求量上升时相对抑制交易费的上涨。Gas Target 与每个区块的最大 Gas Limit 不同，区块可以暂时超过 Target（导致费用增加），但不能超过 Limit，后者对区块大小起到硬性上限的作用。 http://wublock123.com/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=show&catid=6&id=38127

Think of the second order effects in your scenario; our system is run on debt and leverage, so with banks blowing up, and counterparty risk in the opaque Tradfi world... that means anything up for grabs. The global financial system has shifted from direct ownership of securities to a system of “entitlements,” as described in David Webb’s “The Great Taking,” effectively eliminating property rights for book-entry securities worldwide. So why hold anything other than a non-bearer asset? Such as BTC, physical precious metals?
